_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_experiment: REPL_MLP gamma sweep on golden_small, spec2006: instruction gamma x data gamma over [0, 1, 4, 16, 64, 256], fill-counted boost. Generated by tools/mlp_gamma/make_descriptors.py; analyze with tools/mlp_gamma/report.py.
_workload_manager: manual: run the simulations on this machine, at most max_parallel at a time
_max_parallel: 256 is the most pakuchi should run at once; check idle cores (uptime vs nproc) and lower it if other runs are going. tools/mlp_gamma/run_sweep.sh runs one descriptor at a time, so this is the total.
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: A private clone at matthewpipie/scarab main, so sci's in-place hash checkout cannot disturb a working checkout.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces, resolved as <traces_dir>/<suite>/<subsuite>/<workload>.
_top_simpoint: The 6 highest-weight simpoints of each workload, weights renormalized to sum to 1.
_simulations: All 55 spec2006 workloads (rate_int and rate_fp). 10M warmup + the 10M simpoint segment measured per simpoint.
_configurations: gi<I>_gd<D>: --mlp_lin_instr_lambda I, --mlp_lin_data_lambda D, on scarab_f1fce3c. Marking uses main's defaults (mlp_instr_mark 2, mlp_instr_starve 2, mlp_lin_data_thresh 0.7).
